description.value: The Japanese Garden is a botanical garden set within Millennium Park in Creston, BC, in the southern Kootenays. Operated by the Town of Creston, it offers a tranquil cultural landscape in a region known for its agricultural valley and mountain scenery. A touring cyclist passing through Creston on routes connecting the Kootenay Lake corridor would find it a scenic detour in the heart of town.
